catalog.name: Fermi-LAT Fourth AGN Catalog Data Release 3 (4LAC-DR3)

fsrq_selection.rule: CLASS.strip().lower() == 'fsrq'  (4LAC convention: UPPERCASE=identified, lowercase=associated; BOTH kept)

derived_columns.is_identified: True when raw CLASS is UPPERCASE (identified, not merely associated)
derived_columns.ra_deg: RA_Counterpart when a valid counterpart position exists, else RAJ2000
derived_columns.dec_deg: DEC_Counterpart when a valid counterpart position exists, else DEJ2000
derived_columns.position_source: 'counterpart' or 'LAT' — all 755 FSRQ use the counterpart position

sources_fsrq_parquet.note: All 41 original 4LAC columns retained verbatim (Redshift cast to float64); nothing dropped.

verification.note: table-4LAC-DR3-h.fits was re-downloaded from the FSSC on 2026-07-25 and is byte-identical to the 2026-07-21 frozen copy.

icetracks_dr2_companion.status: MIRRORED IN THIS REPO as a release asset (was NOT present before 2026-07-25; the pre-existing 'already delivered' note was a self-report, not a published artifact)
icetracks_dr2_companion.TRAP: Per-file endpoint WITHOUT ?format=original returns a Dataverse-INGESTED, DOUBLE-QUOTE-WRAPPED file whose MD5 does not match the published MD5, while the API filesize field describes the ingested file so a byte-size gate PASSES on the corrupt copy. ALWAYS append ?format=original, or take the whole-release zip.
icetracks_dr2_companion.dr1_superseded: DR1 (doi:10.7910/DVN/VKL316, 2008-2018) is SUPERSEDED and must not be used or combined; only 49.8% of DR1 IC79 and 39.5% of IC86-2011 events survive into DR2.

mirror_verification.contains_originals_not_ingested: confirmed — rows unquoted; IC40_effectiveArea.csv is 148112 B (original) not 152112 B (ingested)

contents.events/<SEASON>_exp.csv: 14 files. Columns run, event, subevent, MJD[days], log10(E/GeV), AngErr[deg], RA[deg], Dec[deg], Azimuth[deg], Zenith[deg]. NO single event_id (identity is the TRIPLE run+event+subevent; ids RESET per season). NO season column — season is in the FILENAME only. AngErr has a hard floor of 0.2 deg.
contents.irfs/<CONFIG>_smearing.csv: ONLY 4 files (IC40, IC59, IC79, IC86), NOT 14 — IC86 covers IC86-2011..2021. 598,080,195 B each. Column Fractional_Counts is NOT a probability density: it is events-in-5D-bin / events-in-that-(E_nu,Dec_nu)-bin. Divide by bin volume for a density. Bin widths vary per cell; unlisted cells are 0.
contents.irfs/<CONFIG>_effectiveArea.csv: 4 files. 40 log10(E_nu) x 50 dec = 2000 rows. Dec bins ARE uniform in sin(dec) (0.04 steps, -1..+1) but are STORED IN DEGREES — convert, do not assume.
contents.uptime/<SEASON>_exp.csv: 14 files. Columns MJD_start[days], MJD_stop[days] ONLY — livetime_days is NOT a column, derive as sum(stop-start).

icetracks_dr2_companion.caution_for_T6: Per-season effective areas and per-season IRFs DO NOT EXIST — there are 4 detector-configuration IRF sets covering 14 seasons, IC86 shared across 11. Any per-season systematic derived from the IRFs is not separable in the public products. This bears directly on the 'season' axis of the requested angular_smearing.zarr.
